period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Sourced directly from the bank's own full unaudited 'Half Yearly Financial Statements 2026' single-page disclosure (same designed infographic-style PDF format as 2026_Q1.json, published on thepremierbankplc.com) -- containing a full Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account, Statement of Changes in Equity and Cash Flow Statement, all headed 'Consolidated'. *** BASIS: CONSOLIDATED, same as 2026_Q1.json, continuing the established mismatch against this dataset's Solo/Bank-Total Q4/annual series. PROOF: (1) this filing's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column (Total Assets 423,820.15m) reproduces exactly against the FY2025 Consolidated Balance Sheet, not Solo; (2) the filing's own 'Disclosure on Un-audited Financial Statements for the Second Quarter Ended on June 30, 2026' box gives a direct Consolidated-vs-Solo comparison as at 30 June 2026: NAV BDT 1,288.00 crore (Consolidated) vs BDT 1,332.06 crore (Solo), NAVPS 10.44 vs 10.80, H1-cumulative EPS (3.15) vs (3.10), discrete-Q2 EPS (2.28) vs (2.27), NOCFPS 9.75 vs 9.75 -- confirming a real, small, and consistent Solo/Consolidated gap. The Solo comparative figures are recorded here only for cross-validation, not as this file's line_items. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (column header 'January to June 2026'), consistent with this bank's project-wide interim convention (_cumulative suffix). UNUSUALLY RICH SOURCE: this filing's P&L also discloses a bonus discrete Apr-Jun 2026 column (not stored as line_items, used only for cross-validation): Total Operating Income 325.13m, Total Operating Expenses 2,296.20m, Profit before provision -1,971.06m, PBT -1,971.06m (nil provision), Tax 839.44m, discrete-Q2 PAT -2,810.50m, discrete-Q2 EPS -2.28. Cross-check: 2026_Q1.json's cumulative PAT (-1,077.28m) + this bonus discrete-Q2 PAT (-2,810.50m) = -3,887.78m, matching this file's own H1-cumulative PAT of -3,887.79m to within BDT 0.01m rounding -- strong confirmation both quarters were read correctly. Validated internally: Total Operating Income 1,064.09m - Total Operating Expenses 4,034.49m = Profit before provision -2,970.39m (exact); nil provision this half, so PBT = -2,970.39m (exact); PBT - Tax 917.39m = PAT -3,887.79m (exact, matches reported to the taka); Total Liabilities 439,230.93m + Total Equity 12,880.03m = Total Assets 452,110.96m (exact). The crisis documented in 2025_Q4.json and 2026_Q1.json deepens further: Consolidated Net Interest Income for H1 is -3,158.52m (interest expense 14,385.32m vs interest income 11,226.80m) and the discrete Q2 loss (-2,810.50m) is larger in magnitude than the Q1 loss (-1,077.28m) -- consistent with the escalating quarter-on-quarter deterioration already documented across FY2024-2025 in this bank's other quarterly files. Equity nearly halved again from Q1's 15,699.63m to 12,880.03m in a single quarter, driven entirely by the discrete-Q2 loss (retained earnings fell from -7,085.47m to -9,895.98m, a change of -2,810.51m, matching the discrete-Q2 PAT to the taka).
